'''Xeelo''', also known as '''Twitcher''', was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who operated a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system's]] succession from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], military patrols were increased in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and on one occasion, Xeelo and a number of other [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] queued in their starships near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], waiting for permission to depart from the world.

==Personality and traits==
Xeelo believed that conditions in the Cularin system were better during the period of time that the system was under Republic martial law than when the system became independent.
